Privacy Policy – Unscrew Bolts

Beveky Games · Effective November 14, 2026

This Privacy Policy explains how Beveky Games handles information in Unscrew Bolts, our Android puzzle game (package: com.bevekygames.unscrewbolts). Contact us at bevekygames.co@gmail.com for questions or privacy requests.

1. Game data stored on your device

Unscrew Bolts does not require a player account. Your stage progress, stars, coins, booster balances and preferences such as sound and music are stored locally on your device. We use this information to remember your progress and settings. The game does not send these save records to a Beveky Games server. Android may back up app data if you have enabled device backup; those backups are governed by your device and Google account settings.

2. Advertising and consent

The game offers optional rewarded advertisements through Google AdMob. Ads may provide in-game items, extra time or moves, or bonus coins. Gameplay does not require you to accept personalized advertising. An internet connection may be needed to load an ad.

The Google Mobile Ads SDK may automatically collect and share information, including your IP address (which may indicate approximate location), device and account identifiers such as the Android advertising ID and app set ID, app interactions such as launches, taps and video views, and diagnostic or performance information. Google uses this information for advertising, measurement, analytics, security and fraud prevention. Google and its authorized advertising partners may process information to deliver and measure ads, depending on your privacy choices and applicable law.

Google's User Messaging Platform may store and process consent choices. Where required, a consent message lets you accept, refuse or manage advertising choices. You can revisit those choices using Settings → Ad Privacy Options when this option is available. You may also manage or reset your advertising ID in Android settings. Refusing personalized ads may affect which ads are available; it does not prevent normal gameplay.

Learn more: Google Privacy Policy (https://policies.google.com/privacy) and How Google uses information from sites or apps that use its services (https://policies.google.com/technologies/partner-sites).

3. Support and communications

If you contact us by email, we receive your email address, message and any information or attachments you choose to provide. We use this information to respond to your request, troubleshoot issues, and maintain necessary support records. Please do not send sensitive information that is not needed for your request.

4. Sharing and legal grounds

We do not sell your locally stored game progress. Advertising information is handled by Google and its authorized partners as described above. We may disclose information when required by law or to protect rights and safety. Depending on applicable law, processing may rely on your consent, the need to provide requested services, legitimate interests such as security and support, or legal obligations. You can withdraw consent where applicable. Google and its partners may process information outside your country, subject to their applicable privacy safeguards.

5. Retention and deletion

Game saves remain on your device until you clear the app's storage, uninstall the game, or otherwise remove them. Device backups may retain copies according to your backup settings. To erase local progress, use Android Settings → Apps → Unscrew Bolts → Storage → Clear data (this also removes your saved progress and preferences). We retain support emails only as long as necessary to respond and resolve issues, or as needed for legal obligations and dispute resolution. You can request deletion of support information by emailing us. Google retains advertising information according to its own retention policies; use Google's privacy controls or contact us for assistance with relevant requests.

6. Security and your rights

We use the Android app storage environment for game saves and Google uses encrypted connections for data transmitted by its Mobile Ads SDK. No method of storage or transmission is completely secure. Depending on where you live, you may have rights to access, correct, delete, restrict, object to or request a copy of personal information, and to complain to a privacy regulator. Contact us to exercise applicable rights. We may need to verify your request.

7. Children

We do not knowingly request children's personal information through player accounts. If you are a parent or guardian and believe a child has provided personal information to us, contact us so we can address the issue. Advertising and consent settings must be appropriate for the player's age and applicable law.

8. Changes and contact

We may update this policy when the game or its services change. The updated policy will display its effective date. For privacy questions or requests, contact Beveky Games at bevekygames.co@gmail.com.
